title: ever LIANNE|Spaghetti Strap V-Neck Pleated A-Line Bridesmaid Dress
descriptionHtml:
Step into elegance with our Spaghetti Strap V-Neck Pleated A-Line Dress, perfect for bridesmaids and special occasions! This stunning gown features a flattering V-neckline and a timeless A-line silhouette that gently flatters all body types. The exquisite pleated design adds a touch of sophistication, cascading gracefully to the floor for a show-stopping effect. Made from high-quality fabric, this dress ensures comfort while you celebrate love and friendship. Whether you're walking down the aisle or dancing the night away, this dress will make you feel like a true belle of the ball!


Fit: Please refer to size chart.


Length: Floor-length


Sleeve Style: Short Sleeve


Closure: Concealed zipper up the back.


Undergarments: It is not padded, with lining.


Fabric:The garment comprises chiffon


Stretch: Fabric is no stretch
